actionPlans.title: Action plans
actionPlans.intro: Save routines you want to return to. Work through them one at a time, at your own pace.
actionPlans.name: Plan name
actionPlans.reminderMinutes: Minutes without moving on before a reminder
actionPlans.estimateHint: Time is split evenly between activities. The first reminder follows the estimated activity time, after at least 30 seconds. The sound then repeats every 15 seconds until you respond.
actionPlans.noEstimateHint: Without an estimate, we show elapsed time. You can change the delay before the first reminder. The sound then repeats every 15 seconds until you respond.
actionPlans.stagesHint: Break a bigger step into stages. We will guide you through each stage instead of the whole step at once.
actionPlans.paused: The plan is paused. Come back when you’re ready.
actionPlans.timeIsEstimate: This is only an estimate. Take the time you need to finish.
actionPlans.reminder: Come back to the current activity. If it’s done, move on.
actionPlans.invalidSound: Choose one of the available reminder sounds.
actionPlans.soundUnavailable: Sound is unavailable. Reminders will still appear on screen.
actionPlans.keepOpen: Keep the app open. Putting your phone to sleep may pause reminder sounds.
actionPlans.confirmDiscard: Discard saved progress? The plan will stay in your list.
actionPlans.confirmRestart: You have saved progress. Start this plan from the beginning and replace the previous run?
actionPlans.emptyHint: Create a plan for cleaning, cooking, packing or your day.
actionPlans.loadError: Could not load plans. Please try again.
actionPlans.saveError: Could not save the plan. Check the names and times, then try again.
actionPlans.deleteError: Could not delete the plan. Please try again.
actionPlans.storageError: Could not save progress on this device. Keep the app open while following the plan.
actionPlans.invalidName: Each name needs text. A plan name can have up to 160 characters and an activity name up to 240.
actionPlans.invalidDuration: Plan time must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
actionPlans.invalidReminder: Reminder interval must be between 1 and 120 minutes.
actionPlans.invalidSteps: Add 1 to 100 steps, at most 100 stages per step and 500 activities in total.
actionPlans.notFound: This plan could not be found. Refresh your list.
actionPlans.visibilityHint: All team members can view and run a team plan. Its author and team administrators can edit it.
actionPlans.onlyAuthorChangesScope: Only the author can change who the plan is for.
actionPlans.teamAccessDenied: You must be a team member to save a plan for that team.
actionPlans.linkedPlan: This plan is attached to a task type. Detach it in the task type editor first.
actionPlans.sameTeamRequired: A task type can only use a plan from the same team.
actionPlans.teamLoadError: Could not load teams. You can still use personal plans.
actionPlans.completesTaskHint: After the last activity, the task will be marked as completed and await approval.
actionPlans.taskCompleted: The task is completed. The usual approval rules apply.
actionPlans.taskCompletionError: Could not save task completion. Your plan progress has been kept. Please try again.
actionPlans.taskTypePlanHint: Choose a plan from this team. To use a private plan, first share it with the team in Action plans.

dayPlanning.title: Day plan
dayPlanning.inclusiveEnd: The end date is the last day of the event.
dayPlanning.timeHint: Times use the event time zone. The end may fall on a later day.
dayPlanning.privateHint: Only the author and invitees see details. Others, including administrators, only see “Busy”.
dayPlanning.sharedHint: All current members of the selected team can see the event details.
dayPlanning.participantsHint: Adding someone puts the event in their plan. They can decline participation.
dayPlanning.adminParticipationHint: As a team admin you can uncheck yourself and put the event on somebody else’s calendar only.
dayPlanning.nobodyAttends: An event without you needs at least one participant.
dayPlanning.chooseTeamToInvite: Choose a team to invite others.
dayPlanning.selectPeople: Choose a team and at least one person.
dayPlanning.doesNotBlock: This event does not block time.
dayPlanning.busyHint: Details of this time slot are private.
dayPlanning.recurrenceHint: Recurrences keep their local time. Nonexistent times during daylight saving changes are skipped. Saving checks conflicts in the first 90 days of the series and the next 90 days. Later dates are included when viewing or planning that range.
dayPlanning.plannerHint: All selected people’s busy times are included, across teams and regardless of tags.
dayPlanning.noSlots: No shared time found. Change the dates, hours or meeting duration.
dayPlanning.noKnownBusy: No known busy time in this range.
dayPlanning.filterHint: Events match any selected tag. Private busy times remain visible; planning includes all blocked times.
dayPlanning.noTags: No tags yet. Add them in “Manage tags”.
dayPlanning.personalTagsWarning: Remove personal tags before sharing the event with the whole team.
dayPlanning.archiveHint: The tag will leave the catalog. Existing assignments will remain.
dayPlanning.invalidTag: Enter a tag name (up to 60 characters).
dayPlanning.conflictHint: These people already have plans at this time. You can still save the event.
dayPlanning.resetHint: This change removes all exceptions in the series, including moved and cancelled days. Occurrences will follow the new schedule again.
dayPlanning.deleteOccurrenceHint: Cancel only this occurrence? Other days in the series will remain unchanged.
dayPlanning.deleteSeriesHint: Cancel the entire event or series for everyone?
dayPlanning.loadError: The complete calendar could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
dayPlanning.requestError: The operation failed. Check your connection and try again.
dayPlanning.saveError: Changes could not be saved. Try again.
dayPlanning.scopeError: Teams, participants or tags could not be loaded.
dayPlanning.accessLost: This event or calendar is no longer available.
dayPlanning.stale: Someone changed this event. Load the current version before editing again.
dayPlanning.invalidTime: Check the dates and times. The end must follow the start and the time must exist in the selected time zone.
dayPlanning.invalidZone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Europe/Warsaw.
dayPlanning.invalidRecurrence: Check the recurrence interval, days and ending.
dayPlanning.invalidPlanning: Check the dates, times and a positive meeting duration.
dayPlanning.restoreHint: Restoring removes the exception and uses the series schedule and fields. Unsaved form changes will be discarded.
dayPlanning.weekScrollHint: Swipe sideways to see more days. Events at the same time appear side by side.
dayPlanning.finishTagFirst: Create the tag or cancel tag creation before saving the event.
dayPlanning.teamTagAdminHint: Team events use team tags. A team administrator can create a new tag.
